footnote.title: About this board
footnote.generated: Generated {{time}}. Sorted by {{metric}}; tiers at alpha {{alpha}}.
footnote.rankClaim: Rank alone is never a claim that one agent beats another. Only tier 2 says an entry is significantly behind the leader.
footnote.scopeAll: Scope all: each entry is measured over its own tasks, so two success rates can rest on different tasks. Tiers still compare each entry with the leader on the tasks both ran.

footnote.scopeCommon_other: Scope common: every entry is measured over the same {{count}} common tasks only.

pValue.name: exact p-value
pValue.definition: Exact two-sided sign-flip test: the share of all 2^n sign patterns of the per-task differences whose mean is at least as far from zero as the observed one.
pValue.denominator: Denominator: all 2^n sign vectors over the n tasks of the primary condition; the task is the unit, so trials of one task never count as separate wins.

mde.name: minimal detectable effect
mde.definition: Minimal detectable effect in pp = (t(0.975, n-1) + t(0.8, n-1)) x SD_d / sqrt(n): the smallest release effect this design detects with 80% power at alpha 0.05.
mde.denominator: Denominator: sqrt(n) over the n tasks; SD_d is the spread of per-task differences, an assumed 0.30 until an A/A run measures it.

costPerSuccess.name: cost per verified success
costPerSuccess.definition: Sum of the cost of every physical attempt at pinned prices, over all assigned slots of the arm, failed runs included.
costPerSuccess.denominator: Denominator: verified successes, runs whose hidden verifier passed under the clean regrade with no veto gate fired.
